query: 社区参与战略 社区参与战略 衡量企业与运营所在地社区进行沟通、资源共建、诉求反馈及长期投入的框架体系。重点考察社区议题识别的科学性、利益相关方参与深度及公益/共建项目的效果评估机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的社区参与战略（包含中长期目标）；定期开展社区需求调查（议题识别）；建立了双向、常态化的社区沟通与反馈机制；具备量化的社会影响力评估（如 SROI 评估或第三方成效审计）。 • 1分（合格）：有明确的公益或社区投入重点（如乡村振兴、教育支持），建立了基础的社区联系路径，有项目进展报告，但缺乏深度的需求调查、闭环反馈机制或系统的效果评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策或战略披露，或仅有零散、无计划的捐赠行为描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：社区参与战略覆盖 >80% 的主要运营地区（如工厂所在地、核心门店网点）或重点公益预算项目。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在总部所在地开展活动，而忽略了外地生产基地或分支机构的社区关系，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 社区参与战略 社区需求调查 利益相关方沟通 社区投入 共建项目 社会投资回报 社区反馈机制 SROI community engagement strategy community needs assessment stakeholder dialogue community investment shared value SROI community feedback mechanism 是否有系统的社区参与战略、中长期目标或明确投入重点？ 是否定期开展社区需求调查或议题识别？ 双向沟通、诉求受理与反馈闭环是什么？ 有哪些共建/公益项目、投入金额及进展？ 是否开展SROI、第三方成效审计或其他量化社会影响评估？ 战略覆盖哪些主要运营地区、工厂所在地、门店网点或重点项目，覆盖比例是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '社区参与战略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有系统的社区参与战略、中长期目标或明确投入重点？ 是否定期开展社区需求调查或议题识别？ 双向沟通、诉求受理与反馈闭环是什么？ 有哪些共建/公益项目、投入金额及进展？ 是否开展SROI、第三方成效审计或其他量化社会影响评估？ 战略覆盖哪些主要运营地区、工厂所在地、门店网点或重点项目，覆盖比例是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有零散无计划捐赠；仅有社会影响评估技术方法而无社区共建；仅有员工志愿服务时长无战略；仅有政府公关活动；区分：社区参与战略强调与运营地社区的沟通共建与长期投入；社会影响评估是项目社会后果识别缓释方法；实质性评估是ESG议题优先级，不是社区战略。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group fulfills our corporate social responsibility by supporting the local communities where it operates. We have been involved in the communities via a wide range of activities. results.section: Approach to Sustainability / 3.1.3. Ensuring Operations in Compliance
results.text: Significant ESG risks | Potential Impacts | Response Approaches The Group will also assess the supplier's performance in a number of ESG areas, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental protection. Sun Ferry has set out its ESG requirements for suppliers in the Supplier Code and favours suppliers who demonstrate a commitment to the principles outlined in the Code in the supplier selection process. To verify that our suppliers meet our requirements and drive improvements, we assess the performance of our existing key suppliers annually against the criteria and procedures specified in the Comprehensive Supplier Evaluation Management Scheme. If suppliers fail to meet our requirements, they are required to develop corrective action plans and take corrective action.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.

The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.

results.section: Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery
results.text: The major contributors to the Group's carbon footprint are fuel consumption of machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels and electricity consumption from the operation of offices and cargo and passenger terminals. The total amount of GHG emissions was 71,394.34 tCO 2 e, Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions were approximately 63,356.95 tCO 2 e and 8,037.39 tCO 2 e respectively. Therefore, the Group strives to reduce our fuel and electricity consumption in order to cut down the associated GHG emissions.

Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery

[Content]
The major contributors to the Group's carbon footprint are fuel consumption of machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels and electricity consumption from the operation of offices and cargo and passenger terminals. The total amount of GHG emissions was 71,394.34 tCO 2 e, Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions were approximately 63,356.95 tCO 2 e and 8,037.39 tCO 2 e respectively. Therefore, the Group strives to reduce our fuel and electricity consumption in order to cut down the associated GHG emissions.
